parse_execution_trace: parse a PyTorch execution trace JSON file and build an ExecutionTrace object with nodes and tensors
list_ops_in_trace: list all unique operators in an execution trace with their counts and input shapes
list_tensors_in_trace: list all tensors in an execution trace with their data types and shapes
generate_trace_graph: generate a GraphML or GraphViz SVG graph visualization of the execution trace
query_node_dependencies: query a specific node or tensor by ID to show its input and output dependencies
